rv.q: This may be a couple of hours of sentimental escapism as the jaws of austerity close on us, but when it is crafted with such mastery, who can begrudge it?
And, even if he rushes to an over-hasty conclusion, it still proves a robustly enjoyable piece, which a critic once accurately compared to "a thick high tea".
To have six comedy greats in one company is an un-missable theatrical coup.
The overall impression is that the company had a ball putting this production together. Happily their enthusiasm proves gleefully infectious.
